subagentRequired.zh-CN:
subagent 执行后端需要 pi-interactive-subagents 扩展，但当前未加载。

解决方式（任选其一）：
1. 安装扩展：pi install npm:@maplezzk/pi-interactive-subagents
2. 运行 /workflow-config 将执行后端切回 workflow

说明：subagent 后端由环境变量 PI_WORKFLOW_BACKEND=subagent 或 /workflow-config 持久化配置触发。
subagentRequired.en-US:
The subagent execution backend requires the pi-interactive-subagents extension, which is not currently loaded.

Fix (choose one):
1. Install the extension: pi install npm:@maplezzk/pi-interactive-subagents
2. Run /workflow-config to switch the execution backend back to workflow

Note: the subagent backend is activated by the PI_WORKFLOW_BACKEND=subagent environment variable or the /workflow-config persisted setting.
